## 1. Behind Her Eyes (2021)
This chilling psychological thriller adapts Sarah Pinborough's best-selling novel. Showrunner Steve Lightfoot (Hannibal, The Punisher) crafts a masterful tale of a woman entangled in a dangerous affair with her boss and a secret friendship with his wife, leading to a shocking twist that redefines everything you thought you knew. The compact 6-episode run ensures a tightly wound, complete story.

## 2. Heartstopper (2022)
Based on the beloved graphic novels, this heartwarming British teen drama is a pure ray of sunshine. It follows the blossoming romance between Charlie Spring, an openly gay student, and Nick Nelson, a kind-hearted rugby player. Its genuine portrayal of young love and friendship makes it a standout in the coming-of-age genre.

## 3. The Witness (2026)
This gripping crime drama centers on a mother's fight for justice when her toddler is the sole witness to her murder. The series delves into the complexities of a flawed investigation, showcasing a desperate partner's efforts to protect the child while seeking the truth. It's a powerful, character-driven narrative.

content_raw: Picture: Netflix British dramas are among some of Netflix’s most successful and celebrated over the years. The streamer has commissioned a lot of them, bringing together some of the UK’s most talented creators. In this list, we walk you through 10 hidden gems that you may have missed the first time around.  Among Adolescence , The Crown , Baby Reindeer , Harlan Coben dramas and, more recently, shows like Legends , Netflix UK has been on top of its game in recent years for developing award-winning, powerhouse dramas. So many shows have broken viewership records — look no further than Adolescence , which remains the streamer’s biggest limited series ever . But what about the ones that never quite reached the astronomical heights of the ‘household name’ dramas? They’re the shows we’re shining the spotlight on today.   From shows dating back almost a decade, to more recent miniseries that deserve your attention if you missed them the first time around, these 10 British series are not to be slept on.   Behind Her Eyes (2021) Picture Credit: Netflix Netflix thriller Behind Her Eyes adapts the best-selling 2017 novel by Sarah Pinborough. The series was brought to the screen in 2021 from Steve Lightfoot, a producer and showrunner with a ridiculously good body of work, ranging from Hannibal to The Punisher to Spider-Noir . Behind Her Eyes follows a mother, Louise (Simona Brown), who has an affair with her psychiatrist boss David (Tom Bateman)… all while secretly befriending his wife. It’s not just a love triangle she finds herself in, but a twisted web of secrets, games, and lies where nobody is who they seem. The supporting cast in Behind Her Eyes includes The Rings of Power star Robert Aramayo, and Eve Hewson ( Disclosure Day ). The series is a 6-episode limited series telling a complete story.   Agatha Christie’s Seven Dials (2026) Picture Credit: Netflix Over the years, the ‘Queen of Crime’, Agatha Christie, has had her stories told and retold myriad times. The most popular adaptations include Murder on the Orient Express , And Then There Were None , and Death on the Nile . In 2026, Netflix released an adaptation of one of her lesser-known stories, The Seven Dials Mystery . Adapted for television by former Doctor Who showrunner Chris Chibnall, this short 3-episode series takes some creative liberties from the original story, but still tells the mystery in full.  The series is headlined by Mia McKenna-Bruce, who plays cunning young investigator Lady Eileen ‘Bundle’ Brent, who uses ingenuity and wit to uncover the mystery behind the murder of Gerry Wade (Corey Mylchreest). The supporting cast is particularly star-studded, with Iain Glen and Helena Bonham Carter playing Lord and Lady Caterham respectively.
